notes.title: v.0.2.7 Hotfix card
notes.content: Now you can take the card from Zosya

notes.title: v.0.2.6 Katia Quest Tracking
notes.content:
A note on the wall now displays Katya’s current quests.
 Katya’s computers (radio and decoder) run faster.
 The game is more stable due to reduced physics calls.
 Added suspense timelines to cutscenes.
 Unnecessary interface disappears when opening a book to avoid distractions.
 Added translations for some missing phrases.
 You can now open Discord by clicking the language hint in-game.

notes.title: v.0.2.5 Report fix
notes.content:
Hints and Interface:

 Interaction hints no longer overlap with the character’s hand.
 Hints are now enabled by default for a smoother onboarding experience.
 Fixed a quest title typo.
 Increased Zose’s voice volume.


Optimization:

 Improved performance by disabling the screenshot camera.
 Removed repetitive empty room dialogue.
 Restored the punch card dialogue.
 VSync is now enabled by default.
 Additional optimizations for screen cameras.
 Removed unnecessary colliders in the city to reduce system load.


Gameplay and Fixes:

 Entering the closet is now smoother.
 Added a light switch for Dankov’s room.
 Fixed Dankov’s fall from the ladder—now it looks natural.
 Eliminated camera blur when focusing on distant objects.
 Refined the madness ghost for a more immersive experience.
 Non-priority inspection reactions now play only after active dialogue.
 Restored missing sound effects for Katya.
 Fixed faith encryption and various other encryption bugs.
 Added an extra position for decrypted punch cards.
 Polished Katya’s final cutscene and Dankov’s opening scene.

notes.title: v.0.2.4 Frequency Hint
notes.content: Added a hint for finding the last radio station before the next character.

notes.title: v 0.2.3 Audio fix
notes.content:
Hiya! Made new fixes related to the radio and dialogues.


 Reduced friends' volume on the radio
 Removed unnecessary dialogues from the father
 Fixed missing lines
 Adjusted the duration of some lines

notes.title: v0.2.2 - Update Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve got a fresh update to make things even better:


 Cards now slide in smoothly, no more hiccups.
 Zosia’s secret ending is back and working like a charm.
 The R&D Institute used to not load properly—now it’s always visible.
 You can hear the flasks clink again in the lab, just like old times.
 The music radio remembers if you turned it on or off.
 Encrypted stations used to play even after decoding their signal—now they remember if they’ve been listened to.


Jump in, have fun, and tell us what you think!
